title: Implement final GitHub release and recovery workflows
description:
The final immutable GitHub Release copies the authenticated escrow asset set exactly once and verifies every public identity.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A protected final-GitHub workflow authenticates tag, npm, GHCR, and escrow completion, enters the constant publication mutex, and creates or resumes only the matching draft without editing candidate escrow.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every escrow asset is copied without regeneration, verified by numeric ID, checksum, attestation, and public URL, then the draft is published once and exact readback precedes completion or recovery-completion.
- [hard] REQ-03: Endpoint/crash fixtures deny edit/delete/replace of published candidate or final assets, reject conflicts and foreign evidence, and recover from escrow/tag/live state without rebuild.

## Notes

Blast radius: final GitHub release/recovery workflow YAML and endpoint fixtures only.
